record.question: A patient after sustaining RTA, developed # left shaft of femur with guarding & rigidity in the abdomen. Following measures to be done EXCEPT
options: X-ray of left lower limb and USG abdomen
Start IV fluid, Ryle's tube and catheterization
Stabilize the #, monitor the patient and do surgery if necessary later on
Grouping and cross matching of two units of blood
record.explanation: Page 6 asks which measure is NOT appropriate for a patient with fracture of the femur and abdominal guarding and rigidity. Deferring surgery for a possible intra-abdominal injury with peritoneal signs is inappropriate; the other measures (imaging, IV fluids, Ryle's tube, catheterisation, cross-matching) are standard.
